mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_cel_rule (rule_name, expression, scope_type, gateway_id, virtual_key_id, status) VALUES (#{ruleName}, #{expression}, #{scopeType}, #{gatewayId}, #{virtualKeyId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_cel_rule SET rule_name = #{ruleName}, expression = #{expression}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, gateway_id = #{gatewayId}, virtual_key_id = #{virtualKeyId}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_name AS ruleName, expression, scope_type AS scopeType, gateway_id AS gatewayId, virtual_key_id AS virtualKeyId, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mcp_cel_rule WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
